text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein departs for London after Geneva.
- Senate speaker says in a speech that the present situation in the Middle East peace process is a "catastrophe".

- Crown Prince Hassan starts a crucial visit to Washington on Sunday; expected to assert Jordan's position of rejecting any changes to the map of Iraq and opposition to the U.S. House of Representatives' resolution on Jerusalem.
- Parliament and political parties condemn the U.S. position on Jerusalem.
- Crown Prince Hassan calls on Washington to end the policy of dual containment of Iraq and Iran.
- Supply Ministry plans to end ration system of basic commodities and replacing it with cash handouts.
- Investment projects close to $500 million over the coming few years are anticipated in Jordan's tourism sector, officials say.
- King: Europe and Russia have a role in the Middle East peace process, but the main role is that of the United States.
